description:
[read-only] Calls, messages and bookings from the selected Google Ads account for this brand. Reads live within the configured date window and limit. Includes consumer contact details; no recording links. No account or customer id is accepted.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/leads/local-services.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

name: ads_local_services_leads
title: Read Google Local Services leads
